researchConclusion: Bounded public checks did not yield usable distinct dealer artwork. Generic text banners or unavailable image-host URLs do not prove that the dealer has no logo. This artwork is clearly an independent proposal.

generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Produce one professional dealer-logo asset on a truly transparent background. Wide horizontal lockup with a separate compact emblem at left, generous transparent gap, and the exact business name at right in bold custom geometric lettering. The emblem must stay clear at 32px, thick strokes and few shapes. Flat crisp vector-like artwork; no gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no photography, no extra text. Every dark element must have a fine white outer keyline and every white element a dark navy outline, so this identical master works on white, charcoal #111113 and dark red #c40101. Use a clean solid silhouette, not decorative outlines. This is an independent proposal, not dealer-approved artwork. Exact name: AVENTUS MOTORS. Left emblem a geometric angular A with two upward wing-like side strokes in dark navy and clear aqua #169ca6; no borrowed luxury brand symbol, no arrow checkmark. AVENTUS large, MOTORS below in clean tracking. Controlled, precise, uncluttered.

compactDerivation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand, derive compact logo. Reproduce ONLY the isolated emblem on the far left of the reference, omitting the adjacent business wordmark entirely. Keep exactly the same motif, lettering inside the emblem, colour palette, navy and white outlines and proportions. Center this one compact emblem on a generous square transparent canvas, no other objects or words. Strengthen only tiny outline irregularities so the emblem is perfectly smooth and clear at32px. Flat crisp graphic, absolutely no speckles, no distressed pixels, no shadows, no gradients, no new geometry or creative changes.

surfaceReview.method: Agent review of exact maintained before/after source raster exports on current consumer backgrounds; unchanged technical pixel checks. New neutral/brand inverse treatment is artwork only and does not change template palettes.
surfaceReview.review: Exact existing spelling and emblem geometry retained. Original inputs and generation provenance remain preserved. Independent proposal; no human/dealer/native/hosted acceptance inferred.
